indicator_name: Approved Beneficiary Women Receiving Monthly Direct Benefit Transfer
indicator_name_ta: மாதாந்திர உரிமைத் தொகை பெறும் தகுதிவாய்ந்த மகளிர் எண்ணிக்கை
indicator_definition: Total number of unique eligible women heads of households credited with Rs 1,000 monthly entitlement via direct bank transfer.
measurement_method: Treasury electronic payment system transaction reconciliation reports.
target_population: Eligible adult women heads of households

indicator_name: Direct Bank Transfer Transaction Success Rate
indicator_name_ta: வங்கி நேரடி பணப் பரிமாற்ற வெற்றி விகிதம்
indicator_definition: Percentage of initiated electronic DBT credit instructions successfully settled into beneficiary accounts without NPCI reversal.
measurement_method: NPCI Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS) / Public Financial Management System (PFMS) logs.

indicator_name: Higher Education Female Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER)
indicator_definition: Total female enrollment in higher education (18-23 years) expressed as a percentage of the eligible female population in that age group.
measurement_method: All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) / Tamil Nadu State Higher Education Council annual report.
data_coverage: All colleges and universities in Tamil Nadu

indicator_name: Government School Girl Student College Transition Rate
indicator_name_ta: அரசுப் பள்ளி மாணவியர் கல்லூரி சேர்க்கை மாற்றம் விகிதம்
indicator_definition: Percentage of girl students passing Class 12 from government schools who transition into tertiary degree/diploma education.
measurement_method: Education Management Information System (EMIS) unified student tracking database.
target_population: Class 12 passed girls from government schools

indicator_name: Cumulative Citizens Screened for Hypertension and Diabetes at Doorstep
indicator_name_ta: வீடு தேடி பரிசோதிக்கப்பட்ட பயனாளிகளின் மொத்த எண்ணிக்கை
indicator_definition: Cumulative unique count of individuals screened at home by Women Health Volunteers using calibrated sphygmomanometers and glucometers.
measurement_method: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam mobile health portal administrative database.
data_coverage: All 388 rural and urban health blocks

indicator_name: Primary School Student Average Daily Attendance Rate
indicator_name_ta: தொடக்கப் பள்ளி மாணவர் சராசரி தினசரி வருகை விகிதம்
indicator_definition: Average daily attendance percentage of enrolled primary school students (Classes 1-5) on working days.
measurement_method: Tamil Nadu School Education EMIS biometric / teacher daily app roll-call.

indicator_name: Annual Count of College Students Completing Certified Skill Modules
indicator_name_ta: சான்றிதழ் பெற்ற திறன் பயிற்சி நிறைவு செய்த கல்லூரி மாணவர்கள்
indicator_definition: Total students completing mandatory semester skill training course and passing assessment with certificate.
measurement_method: TNSDC / Naan Mudhalvan learning management portal database.
target_population: College students across engineering and arts colleges

indicator_name: In-Hospital Road Traffic Trauma Mortality Rate During First 48 Hours
indicator_name_ta: முதல் 48 மணி நேர சாலை விபத்து மருத்துவமனை இறப்பு விகிதம்
indicator_definition: Percentage of admitted severe highway trauma patients dying within first 48 hours of emergency admission.
measurement_method: Chief Minister Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme hospital claims & clinical audit registry.

indicator_name: Greater Chennai Corporation Solid Waste Processing & Diversion Rate
indicator_name_ta: சென்னை மாநகராட்சி திடக்கழிவு சுத்திகரிப்பு மற்றும் மீட்சி விகிதம்
indicator_definition: Percentage of daily municipal solid waste diverted from dumping into processing, composting, and recycling.
measurement_method: Weighbridge records and solid waste balance sheet at Perungudi and Kodungaiyur transfer stations.
target_population: Municipal solid waste generators in GCC
data_coverage: GCC Solid Waste Management Department Annual Operations
